    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        V = state_variables[0, :]
        W = state_variables[1, :]
        Z = state_variables[2, :]

        C = self.C
        I_ext = self.I_ext
        Q_Vmax = self.Q_Vmax
        Q_Zmax = self.Q_Zmax
        T_Ca = self.T_Ca
        T_K = self.T_K
        T_Na = self.T_Na
        V_Ca = self.V_Ca
        V_K = self.V_K
        V_L = self.V_L
        V_Na = self.V_Na
        V_T = self.V_T
        Z_T = self.Z_T
        a_ee = self.a_ee
        a_ei = self.a_ei
        a_ie = self.a_ie
        a_ne = self.a_ne
        a_ni = self.a_ni
        b = self.b
        delta_Ca = self.delta_Ca
        delta_K = self.delta_K
        delta_Na = self.delta_Na
        delta_V = self.delta_V
        delta_Z = self.delta_Z
        g_Ca = self.g_Ca
        g_K = self.g_K
        g_L = self.g_L
        g_Na = self.g_Na
        phi = self.phi
        r_NMDA = self.r_NMDA
        t_scale = self.t_scale
        tau_K = self.tau_K

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        c_glob = coupling[0, :]

        # Derived Variables
        self.Q_V = Q_V = 0.5 * Q_Vmax * (1 + np.tanh((V - V_T) / delta_V))
        self.Q_Z = Q_Z = 0.5 * Q_Zmax * (1 + np.tanh((Z - Z_T) / delta_Z))
        self.m_Ca = m_Ca = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh((V - T_Ca) / delta_Ca)
        self.m_K = m_K = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh((V - T_K) / delta_K)
        self.m_Na = m_Na = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh((V - T_Na) / delta_Na)
        self.lc_0 = lc_0 = Q_V * local_coupling

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(
                t_scale
                * (
                    I_ext * a_ne
                    - g_L * (V - V_L)
                    - (V - V_Na)
                    * (
                        g_Na * m_Na
                        + C * a_ee * c_glob
                        + a_ee * (1.0 - C) * (Q_V + lc_0)
                    )
                    + m_Ca
                    * (V - V_Ca)
                    * (
                        -g_Ca
                        - C * a_ee * c_glob * r_NMDA
                        - a_ee * r_NMDA * (1.0 - C) * (Q_V + lc_0)
                    )
                    - Q_Z * Z * a_ie
                    - W * g_K * (V - V_K)
                )
            ),  # V
            np.asarray(phi * t_scale * (m_K - W) / tau_K),  # W
            np.asarray(b * t_scale * (I_ext * a_ni + Q_V * V * a_ei)),  # Z
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
